scope: Retained source-core, inventory, metrics and review coverage only. No new testing, rendering, raw-PCM audit, human listening, acoustic validation or native acceptance.

definitions.structural: All complete program records and all 204 values checked; family reviews examine authored roles/routes. This is not a listening or acoustic-realism score.
definitions.matched_default: Three aligned .4/.6/.7 metric CSVs,523 rows each. Complete saved patch,48kHz,v.8,p0,hold3/tail1,category-specific note. Equality concerns recorded metric vectors; whole-bank PCM is not retained.
definitions.conditional_mechanism_union: Four .7 mechanisms with nonzero eligible body/rank/VCA route;256 programs. A changed rate/pitch/partial region may be needed; eligibility is not an unconditional output change.
definitions.targeted_actual_patch: Union of named current full-preset observations in A13-A27 and A33-A36. Repeated scenes, diagnostic copies and comparator versions do not add identities. This index is not a census of every test render elsewhere.
definitions.all_bank_gesture_gate: Retained local focused CTest executes LibraryAudit on523 programs:44.1kHz,category-dependent source-note group,v.9,pressure 0 to 1,release near 1.2 s/1.9 s total; separately about 1 s eight-note v1/p1 stress. Bounded scripted source-core behavior, not all musical gestures or native hosting.
definitions.slow_entrance: A34 source timing, cold voice card 0,v.8:14 programs have an active mapped VCA/VCF attack beyond 3 s. Seven have named extended current full-preset captures; seven remain individually unmeasured for that longer hold within this review set.
definitions.human_listening: No human-listening approval is established by this matrix; generated WAVs, numerical metrics and audition packaging do not prove listening occurred.
definitions.register_rate: See each targeted review scope; pitch-wheel travel differs from fresh-note register tests, host sample rate differs from internal oversampling, and a quality comparison does not qualify every rate.
